# Kunal D Soni

> Senior Fintech Product Manager. 12 years building payments, remittance, cards, and digital banking products across the UAE, US, and India.

Headline results (BOTIM Ultra): onboarding conversion 9.7% → 18.8%, +215K active remittance users, 30-day retention 51% → 63%, ~19% YoY revenue growth from cohort-based dynamic pricing across 155+ corridors.

- [Case study: Novo](https://kunaldsoni.github.io/Fintech/case-novo.html): US SME digital banking - payment rails, onboarding automation, AML/fraud
